nodes.label: Baseline Stack — Express / Prisma / Redis / MinIO (Superseded)
nodes.rationale: The originally user-specified stack: Next.js frontend, Node+Express modular monolith, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Redis+BullMQ, MinIO. Predates the stack decision; left uncorrected pending team reconciliation (flagged in 04-key-decisions-and-findings.md).

nodes.label: Multi-Tenant From Day One
nodes.rationale: Shared DB + mandatory tenant_id + central scoping (Postgres RLS as defense in depth); BTG is tenant #1. RBAC + tenant scope on every protected record, enforced centrally not per-screen.

nodes.label: Metric Provenance Labels
nodes.rationale: verified-API / verified-manual / self-reported / estimated / attributed, carried end-to-end — the mitigation for Phase 1's largely manual metrics being oversold as verified.
